description: Source code for an S3-compatible file storage backend in Mattermost, implementing file operations such as upload, download, copy, move, delete, and zip archive creation, with support for encryption, presigned URLs, and cloud-specific configurations.

classes.name: S3FileBackend
classes.description: Struct representing an S3-compatible backend with configuration and client details.

classes.name: S3FileBackendAuthError
classes.description: Error type for authentication errors with S3 backend.

classes.name: S3FileBackendNoBucketError
classes.description: Error indicating that the specified S3 bucket does not exist.

classes.name: s3Trace
classes.description: Custom trace logger for S3 client debugging.

classes.name: s3WithCancel
classes.description: Wrapper for S3 object with context cancellation and timeout handling.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on file extension.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Error string for S3FileBackendAuthError.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Error string for S3FileBackendNoBucketError.

methods.name: NewS3FileBackend
methods.description: Creates a new S3FileBackend instance, detecting cloud environment via environment variable.

methods.name: NewS3FileBackendWithoutBifrost
methods.description: Creates a new S3FileBackend instance without using bifrost.

methods.name: s3New
methods.description: Initializes a new S3 client with signature version and transport options.

methods.name: TestConnection
methods.description: Checks if the S3 bucket is accessible and exists.

methods.name: MakeBucket
methods.description: Creates the S3 bucket if it does not exist.

methods.name: Reader
methods.description: Returns a ReadCloseSeeker for reading a file from S3 with context cancellation.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads entire file content from S3.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in S3.

methods.name: _fileExists
methods.description: Internal check for file existence.

methods.name: FileSize
methods.description: Returns size of a file in S3.

methods.name: FileModTime
methods.description: Returns last modification time of a file.

methods.name: CopyFile
methods.description: Copies a file within S3.

methods.name: DecodeFilePathIfNeeded
methods.description: Decodes old URL-encoded file paths for migration.

methods.name: MoveFile
methods.description: Moves (copies and deletes) a file within S3.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Uploads data to S3.

methods.name: WriteFileContext
methods.description: Uploads data to S3 with a specific context.

methods.name: AppendFile
methods.description: Appends data to an existing file in S3.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from S3.

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Lists directory contents, optionally recursively.

methods.name: ListDirectory
methods.description: Lists directory contents non-recursively.

methods.name: ListDirectoryRecursively
methods.description: Lists directory contents recursively.

methods.name: RemoveDirectory
methods.description: Removes all objects within a directory.

methods.name: ZipReader
methods.description: Creates a zip archive stream of a file or directory.

methods.name: _copyObjectToZipWriter
methods.description: Copies an S3 object into a zip archive.

methods.name: GeneratePublicLink
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for public access.

methods.name: lookupOriginalPath
methods.description: Checks if an original file path exists, for migration purposes.

methods.name: prefixedPath
methods.description: Generates a path with prefix, handling old path lookup for cloud.

methods.name: s3PutOptions
methods.description: Creates options for uploading objects, including encryption and content type.
